questions.q: Why does the lesson say Salesforce certifications are meant to be taken in a sequence rather than any order?
options: Because Trailhead technically blocks you from registering out of order
Because certifications expire if taken out of order
Because each credential assumes the skills of the ones that typically come before it
Because only one certification can be active at a time
questions.explain: The lesson explains that each credential builds on assumed skills from earlier credentials in the sequence.

questions.q: What does the lesson say can happen if someone jumps straight to an advanced exam without the right foundation?
options: Nothing -- exam difficulty is unrelated to prior experience
The exam automatically redirects them to an easier one
Salesforce revokes their Trailhead account
They either fail it, or pass it without actually being able to do the job, which shows up later in interviews or on the job
questions.explain: The lesson warns that skipping the foundation usually means failing the exam or passing it without the underlying skill, which catches up with you later.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what foundation do both the Data Analyst and Technical Architect destinations share?
options: Only the Architect domain credentials
The Administrator credential, then Platform App Builder
Only the Developer credential
There is no shared foundation between the two destinations
questions.explain: The lesson states both destinations share the same foundation: Administrator, then Platform App Builder.

questions.q: What role does the lesson say a practice exam should play in a study plan?
options: It should be used as a readiness check, not as the study plan itself
It should be the entire study plan
It should be taken only after the real exam, for review
Practice exams should never be used
questions.explain: The lesson explicitly describes practice exams as a readiness check that reveals gaps, not a substitute for actually closing them.

questions.q: Why does this lesson avoid handing students a fixed, memorized map of certification names and prerequisites?
options: Because Salesforce certifications no longer have prerequisites
Because this course does not cover certifications at all
Because certification names and requirements can change, and Lesson 10 is dedicated to verifying them directly on Trailhead
Because memorizing a cert map is explicitly forbidden by Salesforce
questions.explain: The lesson notes that certification names and requirements change over time -- for example, the Administrator credential is now listed as 'Platform Administrator' on Trailhead -- which is exactly why Lesson 10 teaches verifying the current source directly.
